title: design tokens.json — the design skill's machine-readable brandbook
description: Validated shape of docs/design/tokens.json. Ships inside the design skill (.claude/skills/design/tokens.schema.json after install) so any editor/tool can validate against it locally — no network fetch required. See CONTRACT.md for the rules this schema is part of.

$schema.description: Conventionally a relative path back to this file, e.g. "../../.claude/skills/design/tokens.schema.json", so editors can validate/autocomplete without a network fetch.

contractVersion.description: Semver of THIS schema (independent of the design plugin's own version). generate stamps the current contract version; a repo whose tokens.json is behind gets called out and migrated, never silently reinterpreted.

source.description: What generate derived this from: a reference image/URL path, or a note like 'existing repo styles' when no reference material was given.

generated.description: ISO date this file was last (re-)derived.

confidence.description: Free-text confidence note, e.g. 'derived-exact' (read off real tokens/variables) vs 'estimated-from-screenshot' (visual guess — flag these, don't assert them as fact).

colors.description: 3-5 named colors per the design skill's floor rule (1 primary, 2-3 neutrals, 1-2 accents). Key names are free-form per repo (e.g. 'accent', 'primary') — apply.ts prefers a key literally named 'accent' when annotating color deviations, but falls back gracefully if absent.

value.description: CSS color value — hex, rgba(), or hsl().

usage.description: Where/when this color is used, in plain language.

iconSet.description: The chosen icon library, if this repo needed one mapped. Omit entirely if the repo doesn't use ad-hoc emoji/symbol icons.

package.description: e.g. 'lucide-react' — prefer whatever the repo already depends on; only propose a new one if none exists.

license.description: Must be permissive (MIT/ISC/similar) — checked before adopting.

style.description: Visual style note, e.g. 'thin, rounded-cap line icons'.

fallbackPolicy.description: What to do when no direct icon match exists — must never be a silently-dropped mapping.

icons.description: Usage classes (named per this repo's own structure — nav, buttons, status, cards, ...) mapping every ad-hoc symbol found in use to a proposed icon.

site.description: Where this symbol is used — file:line or a short descriptive location.

current.description: The symbol(s) currently in use. Multiple equivalents separated by ' / '.

proposed.description: The icon name from iconSet.package this should become.

note.description: Explains a non-obvious substitution — required whenever there's no direct semantic match.

unchanged.description: Things explicitly reviewed and left alone, so the next run doesn't re-flag them as an oversight.

oldThemeCssPath.description: Repo-relative path to the stylesheet generate read the PRIOR palette's CSS custom properties from (e.g. 'app/globals.css'). apply.ts uses this to find old-theme colors still in use; falls back to a short list of conventional paths if absent.
